Description: Irina is a prominent 13th-century commander and feudal magnate within the ancient principality of Polotsk guarding the Western Dvina, holding strategic command over critical frontier castellanies, fortified river redoubts, and hereditary manorial estates. Hardened by brutal seasonal campaigns across the frozen forests and impassable peat bogs of the borderlands, he maintains an elite retinue of armored horsemen, hardened crossbowmen, and auxiliary forest skirmishers. Caught in the deadly geopolitical vortex between the relentless tribute demands of the Golden Horde, the eastward crusade of the Teutonic Knights, and predatory cross-border raids by pagan Lithuanian warbands, he governs his fief with an iron fist, balancing diplomatic intrigue at ducal diets with ruthless defensive mobilization.

Motivations: Defend the territorial integrity and tax privileges of his ancestral estates against rival incursions
Accumulate hardened silver grivnas to maintain his private retinue of mailed cavalry
Secure advantageous dynastic marriages and high offices within the prince's inner council
Values: Feudal loyalty is bound by blood and oath; treachery on the battlefield demands ruthless retribution
A fortress wall is only as formidable as the discipline of the men holding the ramparts
The customs of our ancestors and the sanctity of our faith must never be compromised for gold
Fears: Devastating siege by steppe horse-archers equipped with counterweight trebuchets
Disinheritance and confiscation of hereditary patrimony through ducal decree or boyar betrayal
